blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks.
Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change.
We introduce EvoDuet , a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions and search queries with fixed model parameters.
At each iteration, a retrieval gate lets the LLM assess its knowledge gap and choose to retrieve new documents, reuse stored ones, or proceed without them.
An inner loop refines queries and ranks documents by the solution scores they are predicted to yield; an outer loop generates candidates in parallel from these documents and records the evaluated outcomes for later searches.
Across 21 optimization tasks with one candidate per iteration, EvoDuet raises OpenEvolve’s normalized discovery gain from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, whereas Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit.
Our best runs surpass the previously reported best scores on eight tasks, including Swap Reduction on Q20 and Rosetta, and match them on three more. EvoDuet also improves with other scaffolds (e.g., Top- K K , EvoX) on Sums/Diffs and Denoising, demonstrating its applicability across evolutionary search scaffolds.
blocks.zh:
使用大型语言模型(LLMs)进行进化搜索,在模型缺乏的外部知识需要进展时,可以延缓.
提供相关文档有帮助,但只要添加网页搜索工具就可以随着解决方案的改变而不断返回相同的页面.
我们引入了EvoDuet,一种双层优化方法,通过固定的模型参数共同生成解决方案和搜索查询.
在每次迭代时,一个检索门让LLM评估其知识差距,选择检索新文件,再利用存储的文件,或者在没有这些文件的情况下进行.
一个内环可以按照预期产生的解答分数来完善查询和排序文档;一个外环可以产生与这些文件平行的考生,并记录评估的结果,供日后搜索.
EvoDuet将OpenEvolve的常态发现收益从74.1%提高到78.0%,将GPT-5.6-Luna从61.3%提高到82.3%,将双子座-3.8-Flash提高到82.3%,而Quen3.5-9B则没有好处。
我们的最好成绩超过了以前报道的八项任务的最佳成绩,包括Q20和Rosetta的交换,并在另外三项任务上比对. EvoDuet还与其他脚手架(如Top-K K,EvoX)在Sums/Diffs和Denoising上有所改进,证明了它适用于进化式搜索脚手架.
导言

blocks.en:
Evolutionary search scaffolds driven by large language models (LLMs) ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) have begun to discover new solutions to optimization tasks such as the Erdős minimum-overlap problem ( Erdős, 1955 ) , GPU kernel design ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) , and single-cell RNA-seq denoising ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2026 ) . In these tasks, an evaluator can score any candidate solution, but the optimal solution cannot be computed directly ( Kirkpatrick et al., 1983 ) .
Scaffolds therefore iterate: the LLM proposes candidates, the evaluator scores them, and high-scoring candidates seed the next iteration.
blocks.zh:
由大型语言模型(LLMs)驱动的进化搜索脚手架(Romera-Paredes等人,2024年;Novikov等人,2025年)开始发现优化任务的新解决方案,如Erdás最小重叠问题(Erdás,1955年),GPU内核设计(Oyang等人,2025年),单细胞RNA-seq denoising(Yukekgonul等人,2026年). 在这些任务中,评估人员可以给任何候选解决方案评分,但最佳解决方案不能直接计算(Kirkpatrick等人,1983年)。
因此,脚手架结构:LLM推荐候选人,评价者评分,高分候选人为下一个迭代的种子.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Packing loops of multiple optimization scaffolds
blocks.zh: 图 1. 多个优化脚手架的包装环

blocks.en:
Most scaffolds ( Sharma, 2025 ; Lange et al., 2025 ; Cemri et al., 2026 ) run only this solution loop .
Others keep the solution loop from saturating by wrapping additional loops around it, a design we call Loop Packing (Figure 1 ).
For example, EvoX ( Liu et al., 2026a ) adds a strategy loop that revises the search strategy when progress stagnates.
However, every loop packed so far draws on the same two sources of knowledge: the run’s evolutionary history and the LLM’s parametric knowledge.
The search is therefore closed , and it stalls when progress requires external knowledge that neither source contains (e.g., how to use a newer library version).
Human scientists, by contrast, consult the literature and search again as new knowledge gaps emerge.
blocks.zh:
大多数脚手架(Sharma, 2025年;Lange等人,2025年;Cemri等人,2026年)只运行这个溶液循环.
另一些则通过将额外的环绕环绕来防止溶液循环饱和,这个设计我们称之为环绕环绕环绕环绕环绕环绕环绕环(图1 ).
例如,EvoX(Liu et al., 2026a)增加了一个策略循环,当进度停滞时修改搜索策略.
然而,迄今为止,每个循环都利用了相同的两个知识来源:运行的演化历史和LLM的参数化知识。
因此搜索是关闭的,当进度需要外部知识而两者都不包含时(例如,如何使用更新的库版),搜索就会停滞.
相比之下,随着新的知识差距的出现,人类科学家会查阅文献并再次进行搜索.

blocks.en:
Our preliminary analysis ( § 2.3 ) shows that external knowledge helps LLM-driven search, but not automatically.
Supplying task-relevant and helpful documents at every iteration (oracle documents) raises OpenEvolve’s average Normalized Discovery Gain (NDG) on 31 tasks by 10.3% with Qwen3.5-9B and 4.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna.
Two further observations show that turning such knowledge into progress takes more than a search tool:
First, the LLM needs room to explore: on Sums/Diffs, oracle documents help only when the LLM generates eight candidates per iteration rather than one.
Second, queries must evolve with the solution: on Denoising, an LLM that searches inside the solution loop mostly retrieves pages it has already seen (88.1% of returned URLs) and stops improving after 50 iterations. We therefore co-evolve web search queries with solutions (Figure 1 ), making the search open .
blocks.zh:
我们的初步分析(§2.3)显示,外部知识有助于LLM驱动的搜索,但不会自动.
在每个迭代(oracle)中提供与任务相关且有用的文件,使OpenEvolve的31项任务平均常态化发现增益(NDG)增加了10.3%,Quen3.5-9B和GPT-5.6-Luna的4.0%.
还有两项观察表明,将这种知识转化为进步需要的不仅仅是一个搜索工具:
首先,LLM需要空间来探索:在Sums/diffs上,甲骨文文档只有在LLM每次迭代生成8个候选人而不是1个时才会有所帮助.
第二,查询必须随溶液而演变:在Denoising上,一个在溶液循环内搜索的LLM大多检索它已经看到的页面(88.1%的返回的URL),在50个迭代后停止改进. 因此,我们用解决方案共同进行网络搜索查询(图1),使搜索开放。

blocks.en: Figure 2: EvoDuet co-evolves solutions and web queries. The inner loop evolves queries; the outer loop uses retrieved documents to revise and evaluate solutions. The Swap Reduction example illustrates method transfer (the most common of the six behaviors analyzed in Section 5.1 ): the model applies retrieved routing principles to prioritize gates closer to execution (iteration 5) and penalize reversing the last SWAP (iteration 66). At iteration 64, the gate reuses stored documents without a new web search. The best router found in this run uses 14,835 Q20 SWAPs, 2.31% fewer than the released SimpleTES program ( WILL Team, 2026 ) (15,186) under the same evaluator.
blocks.zh: 图2:EvoDuet共同演变解决方案和网络查询. 内环会演化查询;外环会使用检索到的文档来修改和评价解决方案. " 交换减少 " 的例子说明了方法转移(第5.1节所分析的六种行为中最常见的一种):该模型应用检索的路由原则,优先安排更接近执行的大门(第5段),并惩罚扭转最后的全部门办法(第66段)。 在重复64中,闸门重复存储文件,没有进行新的网络搜索. 在本次运行中发现的最佳路由器使用14,835 Q20 SWAP,比发布的SimpleTES程序(Will Team, 2026)少2.31%(15,186)在同一评价员之下.

blocks.en: We introduce EvoDuet , a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions in an outer loop and web search queries in an inner loop, with the LLM’s parameters fixed. A knowledge-gap-based retrieval gate connects the loops: at each iteration, the LLM assesses what it still needs to know to improve the current solution (its knowledge gap) and decides whether to retrieve new documents, reuse stored ones, or proceed without documents. When it retrieves, the inner loop constructs queries targeting the gap, searches the web, and ranks documents by hypothetical evidence scoring , which predicts the evaluator score of a candidate built on each document. These predictions and the updated knowledge state steer the next round of queries without evaluating any candidate. Given documents, the outer loop generates candidates in parallel and records the documents with the evaluated outcome to guide later searches. Figure 2 illustrates this interplay on Swap Reduction (quantum compilation).
blocks.zh: 我们引入了EvoDuet, 一种双层优化方法, 一个基于知识的gap检索门连接了循环:每次迭代时,LLM都会评估它仍然需要知道什么来改进当前解决方案(其知识差距),并决定是检索新文件,再利用存储的文件,还是在没有文档的情况下进行. 在检索时,内环会构建针对空白的查询,搜索网络,并通过假设证据评分对文件进行排序,该评分预测每个文档上所建候选人的评价分数. 这些预测和最新知识状态指导下一轮的询问,而不评估任何候选人。 鉴于文档,外部环路将同时生成候选人,并将文件与评估的结果一起记录,以指导以后的搜索。 图2说明了这种与 " 交换减少 " (量子汇编)的相互作用。

blocks.en:
We evaluate EvoDuet with OpenEvolve on 21 optimization tasks. With one candidate per iteration, it raises overall NDG from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, and parallel generation improves it further.
Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit, even though oracle documents help it: it often leaves retrieved methods unused or misimplemented (26% of sampled revisions), suggesting that co-evolution requires a model that can both find and apply evidence.
The best runs of EvoDuet surpass the previously reported best scores on eight tasks and match them on three more; on Denoising, EvoDuet surpasses SimpleTES ( WILL Team, 2026 ) at 6.9 × 6.9\times lower estimated cost.
It also improves other scaffolds, Top- K K and EvoX, on Sums/Diffs and Denoising, showing that the search loop can be packed alongside existing loops.
blocks.zh:
我们用 OpenEvolve 评估 EvoDuet 的 21 个优化任务 。 每期有1名候选人,GPT-5.6-Luna的NDG从74.1%提高到78.0%,双子座-3.8-Flash的NDG从61.3%提高到82.3%,平行生成进一步提高了这一水平。
Quen3.5-9B没有好处,尽管甲骨文文档帮助了它:它常常使检索到的方法没有被使用或被错误执行(占抽样修改的26%),说明共同演变需要一种既能找到又能应用证据的模型.
EvoDuet的最好成绩超过了先前报告的8项任务的最佳成绩,并在另外3项任务上比对;在Denoising,EvoDuet以6.9×6.9\时的较低估计成本超过SimpleTES(Will Team,2026).
它也改进了其他脚手架,Top-K K和EvoX,在Sums/diffs和Denoising上,显示搜索环可以和现有的环并排.

blocks.en: Finally, we analyze how retrieved documents shape the search. Candidates improve on their parent in 67.1% of iterations that retrieve a document predicted to beat the parent, compared with 52.1% of iterations without documents. The most common use of documents is method transfer , in which the model applies a retrieved method to its solution (55 of 82 runs). Yet documents predicted to help can also yield much worse candidates (29 of 82 runs), so predicted gains must still be validated by the evaluator.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们分析检索到的文件如何形成搜索。 候选人在检索预计会击败父母的文件的重复中,有67.1%的人的家长情况有所改善,而52.1%的重复没有文件。 文档最常用的用途是方法转移 . 其中,该模型对其解决方案应用了检索方法(82个运行中的55个). 然而,预计会有所帮助的文件也可能产生更糟糕的候选人(82次竞选中有29次),因此,预测的收益仍须由评价员验证。

2.2 实验设置

blocks.en: Tasks. We evaluate on 31 optimization tasks spanning simple scientific optimization (10), quantum compilation (1), astrodynamics (5), scientific algorithms (1), AI foundations (4), mathematics (8), and algorithm engineering (2). Detailed task descriptions are provided in Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh: 任务 我们评价了31项优化任务,涉及简单的科学优化(10)、量子汇编(1)、天体动力学(5)、科学算法(1)、AI基础(4)、数学(8)和算法工程(2)。 详细的任务说明见附录C.1。

blocks.en: Baselines. We use Qwen3.5-9B ( Team, 2026 ) and GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as the LLM ℳ θ \mathcal{M}_{\theta} in OpenEvolve. For each model, we compare (1) OpenEvolve and (2) OpenEvolve with oracle documents supplied to the LLM at every iteration t t . Appendix C.2 describes how we construct the oracle documents. For robustness, we run each baseline with four different random seeds.

blocks.en: 2.3 Does web search help scientific discovery?
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 网络搜索有助于科学发现吗?

blocks.en: Oracle documents improve optimization on average, but their benefits vary across models and tasks. As shown in Figure 3(a) , oracle documents raise the average NDG of Qwen3.5-9B by 10.3% and that of GPT-5.6-Luna by 4.0%. The smaller gain for GPT-5.6-Luna likely reflects limited headroom: OpenEvolve alone already reaches at least 95% NDG on 16 of the 31 tasks. On these tasks, oracle documents change NDG by only 0.1% on average (Figure 3(b) ). Although oracle documents lead to 100% NDG primarily on simple optimization tasks, their benefits also extend to challenging tasks. For example, on Swap Reduction (quantum compilation), oracle documents increase NDG by 6.1% for Qwen3.5-9B and 41.5% for GPT-5.6-Luna (Figure 3(c) ). However, these benefits are not universal: oracle documents lower NDG by more than 1% on 8 and 4 of the 31 tasks for Qwen3.5-9B and GPT-5.6-Luna, respectively, including decreases of 9.0% and 23.3% on Rosetta. Full results are provided in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh: Oracle文档平均改善优化,但其效益因模型和任务而异. 如图3(a)所示,甲骨文文件将Wen3.5-9B的NDG平均增加10.3%,将GPT-5.6-Luna的平均NDG增加4.0%。 GPT-5.6-Luna的增益较小,可能是因为头室有限: OpenEvolve在31项任务中有16项已经达到至少95%的NDG. 在这些任务上,甲骨文文档平均只改变0.1%的NDG(图3(b)). 虽然甲骨文文档导致NDG100%主要用于简单的优化任务,但其好处也延伸到具有挑战性的任务. 例如,关于交换还原(quantum汇编),Oracle文件将Quen3.5-9B的NDG增加6.1%,GPT-5.6-Luna增加41.5%(图3(c))。 然而,这些好处并不普遍:Oracle文件在Quen3.5-9B和GPT-5.6-Luna的31项任务中,分别将NDG降低1%以上,包括罗塞塔的下降9.0%和23.3%。 附录D.1提供了全部结果。

blocks.en: LLMs may need more opportunities to benefit from oracle documents. The mixed effects of oracle documents raise a question: does the LLM lack the ability to use oracle documents, or does it lack sufficient opportunities to act on them? To examine this, we generate N N candidates in parallel at each iteration t t from the same context c t c_{t} . On Sums/Diffs, oracle documents offer no improvement at N = 1 N=1 (14.8% NDG with oracle documents versus 15.4% without), but increase NDG from 25.8% to 40.7% at N = 8 N=8 (Figure 4(b) ). This suggests that the LLM can benefit from oracle documents when given more opportunities to explore strategies grounded in them. Additional results are provided in Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh: 法学硕士可能需要更多机会从甲骨文文件中受益。 甲骨文文件的混合效果提出了一个问题:LLM是否缺乏使用甲骨文文件的能力,还是缺乏足够的机会对它们采取行动? 为了审查这一点,我们在每个迭代 t t 上平行生成 N N 候选人。 在Summs/Diffs上,甲骨文文档在N=1 N=1(14.8%有甲骨文文档的NDG与15.4%没有)时没有改进,但在N=8 N=8时将NDG从25.8%增加到40.7%(图4(b))。 这表明,如果有更多的机会探索基于文件的战略,LLM就可以从甲骨文文件中受益。 其他结果见附录D.2。

blocks.en: Without query evolution, in-loop web search repeatedly retrieves the same pages and stalls. On Denoising with GPT-5.6-Luna, we equip OpenEvolve with Tavily 1 1 1 https://www.tavily.com/ as an in-loop search tool ( joint-level ), allowing the LLM to construct its own queries during solution optimization. We compare this baseline with EvoDuet , which evolves queries based on the LLM’s knowledge gap through bi-level co-evolution. Over 100 iterations, joint-level search uses the tool in 99 iterations and produces 185 queries, compared with 201 for EvoDuet (Figure 4(b) ). However, it retrieves only 85 distinct URLs, compared with 248 for EvoDuet (Figure 4(c) ); 88.1% of its returned URLs have appeared before, compared with 62.4% for EvoDuet . Moreover, joint-level search stops improving after iteration 50, with its best program achieving a held-out NDG of 27.7%, compared with 84.5% for EvoDuet (Figure 4(d) ). These results suggest that evolving what to ask based on the LLM’s knowledge gap helps it search for external knowledge more effectively, enabling it to find better solutions.
blocks.zh: 没有查询进化,在登录网页搜索中反复检索相同的页面和档位. Denoising with GPT-5.6-Luna上,我们为OpenEvolve配备了Tavily 1 1 1 https://www.tavily.com/作为在loop搜索工具(联合级别),允许LLM在解决方案优化期间构建自己的查询. 我们与EvoDuet比较这一基线, 100多个迭代,联合级搜索在99个迭代中使用该工具并产生185个查询,而EvoDuet(图4(b))则有201个查询. 然而,它只检索了85个不同的URL,而EvoDuet(图4(c))为248个;它返回的URL中有88.1%以前出现过,而EvoDuet为62.4%。 此外,联合一级搜索在重复50后停止改善,其最佳程序实现了27.7%的搁置NDG,而EvoDuet为84.5%(图4(d))。 这些结果表明,根据LLM的知识差距来发展要求的内容有助于它更有效地寻求外部知识,从而能够找到更好的解决办法。

blocks.en: Takeaways: Web search benefits from broader exploration and query evolution • Oracle documents increase average NDG across the 31 tasks, with a larger gain for the smaller model (+10.3% vs. +4.0%). • More opportunities for exploration can help LLMs use oracle documents: on Sums/Diffs, oracle documents improve NDG by 14.9% with eight parallel candidates per iteration. • Query evolution helps sustain progress: with comparable query counts on Denoising, joint-level search repeatedly retrieves the same pages and stalls, whereas bi-level search, which evolves queries based on the LLM’s knowledge gap, retrieves about 2.9 × 2.9\times as many distinct pages and increases NDG by 56.8%.

blocks.en: We formulate discovery as a bi-level optimization problem with an outer loop that evolves solutions and an inner loop that evolves queries for web search. As shown in Figure 5 , EvoDuet has three main components: • Solution Optimization Loop (outer, § 3.2 ): The outer loop follows the scaffold’s evolutionary loop ( § 2.1 ) to evolve solutions. At iteration t t , the selection policy ϕ \phi selects a parent solution x t x_{t} and its evolutionary history ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} from the population 𝒟 e \mathcal{D}_{e} , and the LLM ℳ θ \mathcal{M}_{\theta} generates a candidate solution x t + 1 ∼ ℳ θ ​ ( I , c t , 𝒮 t ) x_{t+1}\sim\mathcal{M}_{\theta}(I,c_{t},\mathcal{S}_{t}) , where 𝒮 t \mathcal{S}_{t} is either empty or a set of retrieved web documents. • Knowledge Gap-based Retrieval Gating ( § 3.3 ): This component connects the outer and inner loops, enabling their co-evolution. Based on gaps in the LLM ℳ θ \mathcal{M}_{\theta} ’s current knowledge status, it determines whether to invoke the inner loop for web search. • Query Optimization Loop (inner, § 3.4 ): The inner loop evolves web search queries to retrieve documents 𝒮 t \mathcal{S}_{t} that provide the external knowledge needed to generate an improved candidate solution x t + 1 x_{t+1} . Both loops share the task objective ℰ \mathcal{E} , with query quality defined by the performance of the candidate solution generated from the retrieved documents. Let 𝒮 t ​ ( q ) \mathcal{S}_{t}(q) denote the documents retained from query q q and x t + 1 ​ ( q ) ∼ ℳ θ ​ ( I , c t , 𝒮 t ​ ( q ) ) x_{t+1}(q)\sim\mathcal{M}_{\theta}(I,c_{t},\mathcal{S}_{t}(q)) the resulting candidate. The ideal bi-level optimization is formulated as x ⋆ = arg ​ opt x ∈ 𝒳 ⁡ ℰ ​ ( x ) ⏟ outer: solution optimization s.t. q t ⋆ = arg ​ opt q ∈ 𝒬 t ⁡ ℰ ​ ( x t + 1 ​ ( q ) ) ⏟ inner: query optimization , x t + 1 ∼ ℳ θ ( I , c t , 𝒮 t ( q t ⋆ ) ) , \underbrace{x^{\star}=\argopt_{x\in\mathcal{X}}\mathcal{E}(x)}_{\text{outer: solution optimization}}\quad\text{s.t.}\quad\underbrace{q_{t}^{\star}=\argopt_{q\in\mathcal{Q}_{t}}\mathcal{E}\bigl(x_{t+1}(q)\bigr)}_{\text{inner: query optimization}},\qquad x_{t+1}\sim\mathcal{M}_{\theta}\bigl(I,c_{t},\mathcal{S}_{t}(q_{t}^{\star})\bigr), (1) where 𝒳 = { x 0 , … , x T } \mathcal{X}=\{x_{0},\ldots,x_{T}\} is the set of solutions explored within budget T T , and 𝒬 t \mathcal{Q}_{t} is the set of admissible queries at iteration t t . However, the inner objective ℰ ​ ( x t + 1 ​ ( q ) ) \mathcal{E}(x_{t+1}(q)) is observable only after the corresponding candidate has been generated and evaluated. Repeating this process for every query within the inner loop would be costly. We therefore approximate the inner optimization in Eq. 1 using ℳ θ \mathcal{M}_{\theta} to predict the candidate score that the retrieved documents would yield. Denoting this score predictor by ℰ ^ θ \widehat{\mathcal{E}}_{\theta} , the approximate inner optimization can then be reformulated as q ^ t = arg ​ opt q ∈ 𝒬 t ⁡ ℰ ^ θ ​ ( I , c t , 𝒮 t ​ ( q ) ) \hat{q}_{t}=\argopt_{q\in\mathcal{Q}_{t}}\widehat{\mathcal{E}}_{\theta}\bigl(I,c_{t},\mathcal{S}_{t}(q)\bigr) . The detailed algorithm is presented in Algorithm 1 .

3.3 基于知识的检索

blocks.en: The gate allows ℳ θ \mathcal{M}_{\theta} to determine when to search by assessing whether it needs new external knowledge to improve the current solution x t x_{t} , can reuse information stored in 𝒟 s \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{s}} , or can evolve the solution using only its internal knowledge. At each iteration, given the context c t c_{t} and the documents most recently stored in 𝒟 s \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{s}} , ℳ θ \mathcal{M}_{\theta} outputs its current knowledge state K t K_{t} and a retrieval decision g t g_{t} : ( K t , g t ) = Gate ℳ θ ​ ( c t , 𝒟 s ) , g t ∈ { no-op ¯ ¯ , look-up ¯ ¯ , retrieve ¯ ¯ } . (K_{t},g_{t})=\textsc{Gate}_{\mathcal{M}_{\theta}}\bigl(c_{t},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{s}}\bigr),\qquad g_{t}\in\{{\color[rgb]{0.4766,0.3711,0.7695}\overline{\underline{\textsc{no-op}}}},{\color[rgb]{0.9414,0.6406,0.1641}\overline{\underline{\textsc{look-up}}}},{\color[rgb]{0.3086,0.5273,0.8125}\overline{\underline{\textsc{retrieve}}}}\}. (3) The knowledge state K t K_{t} distinguishes the model’s existing knowledge, findings from previous searches and experiments, and unresolved questions about x t x_{t} that define the current knowledge gap. The gate selects no-op ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{no-op}}} when the model’s knowledge suffices, look-up ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{look-up}}} when stored documents provide the missing knowledge, and retrieve ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{retrieve}}} when neither source is sufficient. Under look-up ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{look-up}}} , the selected documents are included in the solution prompt without a new web search. This makes retrieval responsive to the current knowledge gap and enables the reuse of previously retrieved evidence. The results in Table 1(b) show that knowledge-gap-based gating is more effective than the heuristic gating based on stalled progress used in EvoX ( Liu et al., 2026a ) .

blocks.en: EvoDuet improves discovery, but only for LLMs that can exploit retrieved evidence. At N = 1 N=1 , Figure 6(a) shows that EvoDuet improves OpenEvolve’s overall NDG from 74.1% to 78.0% (+3.9%) with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% (+21.0%) with Gemini-3.8-Flash. Qwen3.5-9B, however, shows a 14.4% decline at N = 1 N=1 and still loses 4.7% with parallel generation at N = 8 N=8 , despite gaining 10.3% when given oracle documents (Figure 3(a) ). Unlike the oracle setting, EvoDuet requires the model to decide when and what to search for based on its own knowledge gaps. This contrast suggests that these additional demands may limit the benefits of retrieval for weaker backbones such as Qwen3.5-9B. Inspection of 50 randomly sampled Qwen3.5-9B revisions with documents at N = 1 N=1 identifies unused methods in 6% and incorrect implementations in 20% (26% combined; Appendix E.3 ). These findings suggest that effective bi-level co-evolution depends on the model’s ability to both retrieve and apply relevant evidence.
blocks.zh: EvoDuet改进了发现,但只针对能够利用检索证据的LLMs. 在N=1 N=1时,图6(a)显示EvoDuet将OpenEvolve的总体NDG从74.1%提高到78.0%(+3.9%),GPT-5.6-Luna从61.3%提高到82.3%(+21.0%),双子座-3.8-Flash。 然而,Quen3.5-9B显示,N=1N=1的下降率为14.4%,而N=8N=8的平行生成率仍然下降了4.7%,尽管在给与甲骨文文件(图3(a)时获得了10.3%。 与甲骨文设定不同,EvoDuet要求模型根据自身的知识差距来决定搜索的时间和内容. 这一对比表明,这些额外的要求可能会限制检索对较弱的骨干如Quen3.5-9B的效益. 检查50个随机抽查的Wen3.5-9B订正案,文件编号为N=1N=1,发现未使用的方法占6%,执行错误占20%(合26%;附录E.3)。 这些调查结果表明,有效的双层共同演变取决于模型是否有能力检索和应用相关证据。

blocks.zh: 图7:N的放大效应

blocks.en: Parallel generation consistently improves discovery across models. Figure 6(a) shows that increasing the candidate budget from N = 1 N=1 to N = 8 N=8 improves EvoDuet ’s overall NDG for all three models. For Qwen3.5-9B, although EvoDuet remains below the corresponding OpenEvolve baseline at both budgets, its overall NDG improves from N = 1 N=1 to N = 8 N=8 , indicating that parallel generation also benefits this model. We further compare N ∈ { 1 , 8 , 16 } N\in\{1,8,16\} for GPT-5.6-Luna and Gemini-3.8-Flash on 8 tasks in Figure 7 . We observe that the average NDG increases monotonically with N N for both models, rising from 89.6% to 95.7% for GPT-5.6-Luna and from 84.5% to 89.6% for Gemini-3.8-Flash. These results suggest that broader exploration guided by web documents helps LLMs discover better solutions.

EvoDuet achieves its largest average gain in mathematics. As shown in Figure 6(b) , EvoDuet improves NDG over OpenEvolve on mathematics tasks in five of the six model/budget settings, with an average gain of 7.1% across all six. At N = 8 N=8 , Qwen3.5-9B gains 5.5% despite its negative overall gain, and Gemini-3.8-Flash gains 6.7%.
blocks.zh: 埃沃杜埃特在数学方面实现了最大的平均收益. 如图6(b)所示,EvoDuet在六个模型/预算设置中,有五个模型/预算环境中的数学任务比OpenEvolve改进了NDG,所有六个模型/预算的平均收益为7.1%。 N = 8 N = 8, Quen3.5-9B 增益5.5%,尽管总收益为负数,双子座-3.8-闪光增益 6.7%。

blocks.en: EvoDuet discovers novel solutions across 11 different tasks. Table 1(a) shows that EvoDuet surpasses the previous SOTA program scores on eight tasks across five domains and matches them on three more. The mean cost across the eleven reported runs is $45.56. Interestingly, on Rosetta and Erdős, the model initially evolves solutions, then retrieves public constructions at a later iteration and uses them as starting points for further optimization: refining a published trajectory and locally optimizing a published construction ( C 5 : 0.380859 → 0.380859 C_{5}:0.380859\rightarrow 0.380859 ), respectively. We call this behavior public artifact reuse , one of six behaviors reported in Appendix E.1 . This behavior occurs in only 6 of 82 GPT-5.6-Luna runs (7.3%), compared with method transfer (55 of 82), in which the model applies principles or methods retrieved by searching relevant literature (Figure 8(c) ). Only two of these 11 SOTA results reuse public artifacts in their best programs (in Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: EvoDuet在11个不同的任务中发现了新的解决方案. 表1(a)显示,EvoDuet在5个领域的8项任务上超过了先前的SOTA程序得分,并在另外3个领域上进行了匹配. 11次报告的平均费用为45.56美元。 有趣的是,在Rosetta和Erdás上,该模型最初会演化溶液,然后在后来的迭代中检索公共建筑,并将其作为进一步优化的起点:精炼已公布的轨迹,在当地优化已公布的建筑(C 5:0.380859 → 0.380859 C_{5}:0.380859\rightarrow 0.380859)). 我们称这种行为为公共文物再利用, 这种行为发生在82GPT-5.6-Luna运行(7.3%)中的6个,而方法传输(82的55个)则采用通过搜索相关文献检索的原则或方法(图8(c)). 这11种SOTA中只有两种结果在最佳方案(附录K)中重新使用公共文物.

blocks.en: The largest median gain occurs on partially solved tasks. Figure 6(c) compares OpenEvolve and EvoDuet across 126 combinations of tasks, models, and candidate counts. When OpenEvolve’s NDG is 5–20%, 20–40%, 40–60%, and 60–80%, the median gains from EvoDuet are -5.4%, +17.5%, +9.2%, and +2.4%, respectively. When OpenEvolve already performs well (NDG ≥ \geq 80%), the median gain is 0.0% across 75 comparisons. Of the 52 comparisons with OpenEvolve NDG ≥ \geq 95%, six show declines greater than 5%. When OpenEvolve makes little progress (NDG below 5%), EvoDuet raises five of the ten cases above 5%, with a median gain of +71.8% among these five. In the remaining five cases, both methods stay near the initial program’s performance. Overall, EvoDuet tends to provide smaller gains when OpenEvolve’s NDG is higher (Pearson r = − 0.41 r=-0.41 ).

blocks.en: Hypothetical evidence scores track actual program performance. Across 4,324 retrievals, hypothetical evidence scores correlate strongly with the selected candidates’ evaluated scores (Spearman ρ = + 0.86 \rho=+0.86 ; Figure 8(a) ). Correlations are positive on all 21 tasks, with a median of + 0.74 +0.74 . This supports using these scores as a surrogate signal for inner-loop query optimization ( § 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 伪证分数跟踪实际程序性能. 在4,324项检索中,假设证据分数与选定的候选人的评定分数密切相关(Spearman ^ = + 0.86\rho=0.86;图8(a))。 在所有21项任务中,关联性为正值,中间值为+ 0.74+0.74. 这支持使用这些分数作为内闲查询优化的代位信号(§3.4).

blocks.en: Programs improve more often with promising documents. A document is promising when its hypothetical evidence score exceeds the parent’s actual evaluator score, i.e., s ^ t ​ ( d ) > ℰ ⁡ ( x t ) \hat{s}_{t}(d)>\mathcal{E}(x_{t}) . When retrieve ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{retrieve}}} retains at least one such document, the selected candidate improves on its parent in 67.1% of iterations and sets a new run best in 14.1%, compared with 52.1% and 9.6% under no-op ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{no-op}}} (Figure 8(b) ). Under look-up ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{look-up}}} , which reuses stored documents, these rates are 61.2% and 10.1%, respectively. On 17 of 21 tasks, parent improvement rates are higher with promising documents than under no-op ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{no-op}}} (medians: 69% vs. 54%). However, 36.5% of retrievals yield no promising document; the parent improvement rate in these cases is only 38.3%. These results suggest that hypothetical evidence scoring helps identify documents useful for improving the current solution.
blocks.zh: 方案往往通过有希望的文件加以改进。 文件如果假设证据分数超过亲方的实际评估分数, 即 s^ t (d) > E → (x t)\hat{s}_{t} (d)}}\ mathcal{E}(x_{t}), 则有希望。 当检索到“ 覆盖线”\ underline\ textsc{ retrieve} 至少保留一个这样的文件,被选中的候选人在67.1%的重复中提高了其父的素质,在14.1%中设置了新的运行最佳,而在“不超越线”下则设置了52.1%和9.6%。 (图8(b)). 在重用所储存文件的查询上,这些比率分别为61.2%和10.1%。 在21项任务中,17项任务中,有希望的文件的家长改进率高于“无线”下(69%对54%)。 然而,36.5%的检索没有产生有希望的文件;在这种情况下,父母的改进率只有38.3%。 这些结果表明,假设证据评分有助于确定有助于改进目前解决办法的文件。

blocks.en: Web documents mainly provide methods and performance targets. Figure 8(c) summarizes six behavior categories across 82 GPT-5.6-Luna runs (8,200 iterations), with each run counted once in every applicable category. The most common behaviors are applying principles and methods from retrieved documents (55 runs) and using published best scores as reference targets (40 runs). These targets guide program development, while the task evaluator measures the resulting programs’ performance. We also observe reuse of published solutions (6 runs) and unsuccessful revisions inspired by retrieved ideas (29 runs). Detailed explanations are presented in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh: 网络文档主要提供方法和绩效目标. 图8(c)概括了82个GPT-5.6-Luna运行的6个行为类别(8 200次迭代),每个运行在每一个适用类别中计算一次。 最常见的行为是应用从检索到的文档(55运行)中的原则和方法,并将公布的最佳分数作为参考目标(40运行). 这些目标指导了方案的制定,而任务评估者则衡量由此产生的方案业绩。 我们还观察到对已公布的解决方案(6次运行)的重复使用,以及因检索到的想法(29次运行)而导致的修订失败。 详细解释见附录E.1。

blocks.en: The knowledge-gap-based gate achieves the highest NDG. Table 1(b) compares random gating ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ), a stagnation heuristic ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , and our knowledge-gap-based gate. Our gate performs best on both Denoising and Erdős, with a particularly large gain of 23.9% over the stagnation heuristic on Denoising. This highlights the importance of the model’s assessment of its own knowledge state when deciding whether to search the web.
blocks.zh: 基于知识的gap门实现最高的NDG. 表1(b)比较随机成形(p = 0.5 p = 0.5),一种停滞的heuristic(Liu等人,2026a),以及我们的基于知识的gap门. 我们的大门在德诺瓦辛格和埃尔达斯都表现最好,在德诺瓦辛格的停滞中,特别大的收益为23.9%. 这凸显了模型在决定是否搜索网络时对自己的知识状态进行评估的重要性.

blocks.en: Bi-level optimization is an effective way to couple web search with solution evolution. We compare four variants: OpenEvolve without web search, OpenEvolve with an in-loop search tool (joint-level), DeepEvolve (sequential), and EvoDuet (bi-level). A detailed comparison of these variants is provided in Appendix B.5 . In Table 1(c) , EvoDuet outperforms all other methods on three tasks, highlighting the importance of the bi-level design.
blocks.zh: 双层优化是将网络搜索与解决方案演化结合的有效方式. 我们比较了四个变体:没有网络搜索的OpenEvolve,与在loop搜索工具的OpenEvolve(联合级别),DeepEvolve(序列)和EvoDuet(双级别). 附录B.5详细比较了这些变体。 在表1(c)中,EvoDuet在三项任务上超越了所有其他方法,突出了双层设计的重要性.

blocks.en: EvoDuet integrates effectively with existing scaffolds. Table 1(d) compares OpenEvolve, Top- K K , and EvoX with and without EvoDuet . EvoDuet improves NDG on Sums/Diffs and Denoising across all three scaffolds, with respective gains of 23.5 and 84.5 for OpenEvolve, 46.7 and 63.6 for Top- K K , and 55.1 and 37.8 for EvoX. Although EvoX already includes a solution loop and a meta-level strategy loop, adding EvoDuet ’s web search loop yields substantial gains, highlighting the benefits of packing the loop (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: EvoDuet与现有的脚手架有效融合. 表1(d)将OpenEvolve、Top-K K和EvoX与EvoDuet进行比较。 EvoDuet在Sums/Diffs和Denoising上改进了所有三个脚手架上的NDG,OpenEvolve的成绩分别为23.5和84.5,Top-K K的成绩分别为46.7和63.6,EvoX的成绩分别为55.1和37.8。 虽然EvoX已经包含一个解决方案循环和一个元级策略循环,但加入EvoDuet的网络搜索循环会产生巨大的收益,凸显了包装循环的好处(图1).

blocks.en:
Cost efficiency. Table 1(e) compares SimpleTES ( WILL Team, 2026 ) , the best observed OpenEvolve runs, and EvoDuet on Denoising. EvoDuet achieves 100.27% NDG at $38.45, a 6.9 × 6.9\times reduction in cost compared with SimpleTES (100% NDG at an estimated API-equivalent cost of $265.39).
These results suggest that bi-level co-evolution enables cost-efficient performance by retrieving relevant external knowledge when the model needs it, despite the additional cost of web search.
blocks.zh:
成本效益。 表1(e)比较了SimpleTES(Will Team, 2026),观测到的OpenEvolve运行情况最佳,以及Denoising上的EvoDuet. EvoDuet以38.45美元的价格实现了100.27%的NDG,与SimpleTES相比,费用减少了6.9×6.9\次(NDG100%,估计API等价265.39美元)。
这些结果表明,尽管网页搜索费用增加,但是在模型需要时,通过检索相关的外部知识,双层联合演进可以提高成本效益。
6 相关工作

blocks.en:
LLM-driven evolutionary scaffolds use prior candidates and evaluation feedback to improve programs ( Novikov et al., 2025 ; Sharma, 2025 ; Lange et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026f ) .
GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2025 ) optimizes prompts, while other methods evolve agent or harness code ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026e ) .
Most of these methods operate within a single solution loop.
EvoX ( Liu et al., 2026a ) adds a meta-level loop that evolves search strategies alongside solutions, but both loops draw on the LLM’s existing knowledge and the run’s evolutionary history. DeepEvolve ( Liu et al., 2025 ) adds a web search loop, but couples search and solution optimization sequentially rather than through a bi-level formulation.
blocks.zh:
LLM驱动的进化脚手架使用前期候选人和评价反馈来改进方案(Novikov等人,2025年;Sharma,2001年)。 2025年;Lange等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年;Qu等人,2026年;Yukekgonul等人,2026年;Lee等人,2026年f月).
GEPA(Agrawal等人,2025年)优化了提示,而其他方法则演化出代理或牵引码(张等人,2025年;张等人,2026年;李等人,2026年e).
这些方法大多在一个单一的解决方案循环内运作.
EvoX(Liu et al., 2026a)增加了一个元级的循环, 将搜索策略与解决方案一起演化, DeepEvolve(Liu et al.,2025)增加了一个网络搜索循环,但情侣搜索和解决方案优化按顺序进行,而不是通过双层配方进行.
7 结论

blocks.en: We introduce EvoDuet , a bi-level method that co-evolves solutions and web search queries, letting the LLM’s knowledge state decide when to search and what to ask. Across 21 tasks, EvoDuet improves OpenEvolve with GPT-5.6-Luna and Gemini-3.8-Flash (but not Qwen3.5-9B), surpasses the best previously reported scores on eight tasks, and improves Top- K K and EvoX on Sums/Diffs and Denoising.
blocks.zh: 由LLM的知识状态决定何时进行搜索, 在21项任务中,EvoDuet用GPT-5.6-Luna和双子座-3.8-Flash改进了OpenEvolve(但不包括Quen3.5-9B),超越了以前报告的8项任务的最佳得分,并在Sums/Diffs和Denoising上改进了Top-K和EvoX.

blocks.en: This work evaluates LLM-guided computational optimization across a set of tasks, using publicly available web sources to inform the search. To support proper attribution, we document cases of public artifact reuse, including the original sources and subsequent optimization steps, in Appendices E.1 and K . The reported gains reflect performance under the task evaluators used in this study. The resulting programs require independent validation before use in other settings. Appendix H discusses source attribution, the reliability of retrieved information, program validation, and human oversight of downstream applications.

blocks.en:
LLM-driven discovery methods differ in whether they optimize candidate programs, search procedures, prompts, or model parameters.
FunSearch ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ) , AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) , OpenEvolve ( Sharma, 2025 ) , and CodeEvolve ( Assumpção et al., 2025 ) use execution feedback to evolve programs.
EoH ( Liu et al., 2024 ) jointly evolves heuristic descriptions and code.
At the search level, ShinkaEvolve ( Lange et al., 2025 ) , PACEvolve ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , and AdaEvolve ( Cemri et al., 2026 ) adapt selection, context management, and exploration, respectively, while EvoX ( Liu et al., 2026a ) jointly evolves solutions and search strategies.
The Darwin Gödel Machine ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , Hyperagents ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026e ) optimize agent or harness code.
CORAL ( Qu et al., 2026 ) coordinates collaborative evolution through shared memory, and SkyDiscover ( Liu et al., 2026b ) provides modular discovery infrastructure.
OPRO ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , APO ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ) , TextGrad ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ) , and GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2025 ) optimize prompts or textual variables using performance feedback or textual critiques.
ThetaEvolve ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and TTT-Discover ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2026 ) update model parameters through reinforcement learning during search, while Kernel-Smith ( Du et al., 2026 ) and Evolution Fine-Tuning ( Lee et al., 2026f ) train on evolutionary trajectories.
blocks.zh:
LLM驱动的发现方法在它们是优化候选程序,搜索程序,提示,还是模型参数方面有所不同.
FunSearch(Romera-Paredes等人,2024年),AlphaEvolve(Novikov等人,2025年),OpenEvolve(Sharma,2025年),CodeEvolve(Assumpção等人,2025年)使用执行反馈来演化程序.
EoH (Liu et al., 2024) 联合演化了heuristic的描述和代码.
在搜索层面,ShinkaEvolve(Lange等人,2025年),PACEvolve(Yan等人,2026年)和AdaEvolve(Cemri等人,2026年)分别调整选择,上下文管理和探索,而EvoX(Liu等人,2026年a)则联合演化解决方案和搜索策略.
达尔文·格德尔机器(张等人,2025年),超能剂 (Zhang等人,2026年),和Meta-Harness(Lee等人,2026年e)优化剂或牵引码.
CORAL(Qu等人,2026年)通过共享内存协调协作进化,SkyDiscover(Liu等人,2026年b)提供模块化的发现基础设施.
OPRO(Yang等人,2023年),APO(Pryzant等人,2023年),TextGrad(Yukekgonul等人,2024年),GEPA(Agrawal等人,2025年)利用性能反馈或文字批评来优化提示或文字变量.
ThetaEvolve(Wang等人,2025年)和TTT-Discover(Yukekgonul等人,2026年)在搜索过程中通过强化学习更新模型参数,而Kernel-Smith(Du等人,2026年)和Evolution Fine-Tuning(Lee等人,2026年f月)列车则在演化轨迹上进行更新.

blocks.en:
DeepEvolve ( Liu et al., 2025 ) sequentially couples deep research with program revision and evaluation, using prior evaluation outcomes to guide subsequent research.
KernelEvolve ( Liao et al., 2025 ) uses runtime diagnostics to guide retrieval for kernel optimization.
AI co-scientist ( Gottweis et al., 2025 ) integrates literature search into hypothesis generation and scientific review.
Robin ( Ghareeb et al., 2026 ) uses literature search to propose and assess candidate hypotheses, then incorporates experimental feedback into subsequent refinement.
The AI Scientist ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , AI-Researcher ( Tang et al., 2025 ) , and Agent Laboratory ( Schmidgall et al., 2025 ) connect literature search, computational experiments, and reporting.
AgentRxiv ( Schmidgall and Moor, 2025 ) and AgenticSciML ( Jiang and Karniadakis, 2026 ) reuse accumulated research reports or method memories.
Coscientist ( Boiko et al., 2023 ) , ChemCrow ( Bran et al., 2024 ) , and Biomni ( Huang et al., 2026 ) combine external information with scientific tools.

KernelEvolve(Liao等人,2025年)使用运行时诊断法指导检索,以进行内核优化.

AI科学家(Lu等人,2026年),AI-Researcher(Tang等人,2025年),代理实验室(Schmidgall等人,2025年)将文献搜索,计算实验和报告联系起来.

科学家(Boiko等人,2023年),ChemCrow(Bran等人,2024年),Biomni(Huang等人,2026年)将外部信息与科学工具相结合.

blocks.en:
Retrieval methods address when to search and how to refine queries.
ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , IRCoT ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ) , Iter-RetGen ( Shao et al., 2023 ) , and Auto-RAG ( Yu et al., 2024 ) guide successive retrieval steps using intermediate reasoning, answers, or observations.
Self-RAG ( Asai et al., 2023 ) , FLARE ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , Adaptive-RAG ( Jeong et al., 2024 ) , and CRAG ( Yan et al., 2024 ) base retrieval decisions on reflection, uncertainty, question complexity, and evidence quality, respectively.
Rewrite-Retrieve-Read ( Ma et al., 2023 ) learns query reformulation, while RQ-RAG ( Chan et al., 2024 ) learns rewriting, decomposition, and disambiguation.
Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , R1-Searcher ( Song et al., 2025 ) , and ReSearch ( Chen et al., 2025 ) learn search policies from outcome rewards.
REPLUG ( Shi et al., 2024 ) uses feedback from a frozen LM to train a retriever, while ITER ( Chen et al., 2026 ) trains a retriever conditioned on reasoning and search histories. EvoDuet couples solution and query evolution through a shared task objective. Its knowledge-state gate chooses whether to retrieve new documents, reuse stored documents, or skip retrieval. The inner loop selects evidence using predicted candidate scores and refines queries without generating or evaluating programs. The outer loop records measured outcomes to inform subsequent retrieval decisions. Model parameters and prompt templates remain fixed throughout.
blocks.zh:
检索方法涉及何时搜索以及如何完善查询。
ReAct(Yao等人,2023年),IRCoT(Trivedi等人,2023年),Iter-RetGen(Shao等人,2023年),Auto-RAG(Yu等人,2024年)用中间推理,答案或观察来指导连续的检索步骤.
Self-RAG(Asai等人,2023年),FLARE(Jiang等人,2023年),适应性-RAG (Jeong等人,2024年),和CRAG(Yan等人,2024年)分别根据反射,不确定性,问题复杂性和证据质量等基础检索决定.
重写-Retrive-Read(Ma等人,2023年)学习查询重写,而RQ-RAG(Chan等人,2024年)学习重写,解析,解析.
搜索-R1(Jin等人,2025年),R1-Searcher (Song et al., 2025),和ReSearch(Chen et al., 2025)从结果奖励中学习搜索政策.

blocks.en: B.5 Coupling Web Search with Solution Evolution
blocks.zh: B.5 网络搜索与解决方案演变

blocks.en: Figure 9 compares three ways to integrate web search into OpenEvolve: joint-level retrieval (Table 2 ), sequential retrieval as in DeepEvolve ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , and bi-level retrieval in EvoDuet . They differ in when they search, what guides their queries, and how they reuse search results.
blocks.zh: 图9比较了将网络搜索整合到OpenEvolve中的三种方法:联合级检索(表2),依次检索如DeepEvolve(Liu等人,2025),以及EvoDuet的双级检索. 它们在搜索时不同,哪些指导他们的查询,以及如何再利用搜索结果.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Three ways to couple web search with solution evolution. Top: search runs within generation (joint-level), precedes generation (sequential), or co-evolves with solutions (bi-level). Blue denotes search, violet solution evolution, and amber the knowledge-gap gate; the dashed overlap marks the coupling between the two loops. Bottom: search timing, query guidance, and memory for reuse across iterations. Checkmarks highlight EvoDuet ’s design choices.
blocks.zh: 图9:将网络搜索与解决方案演化结合起来的三种方式. Top:搜索运行在生成内部(联合级),先生成(序列),或与解决方案共同演化(双层). 蓝色表示搜索,紫色溶液演化,并琥珀知识-gap门;破碎的重叠标志着两个环之间的耦合. 底部:搜索时间,查询指导,以及内存,用于跨迭代的再利用. EvoDuet 的设计选择。

blocks.en: Joint-level retrieval runs during program generation: the LLM writes queries alongside program edits and must call Tavily at least once per iteration, with up to three tool rounds. Sequential retrieval, as in DeepEvolve, runs a deep-research agent before generation at every iteration. Given the current program and programs selected as inspiration, the agent plans research questions, searches the web, and writes a proposal. Reflection can revisit planning or search when it judges the report incomplete; a coding agent then implements the proposal, followed by debugging and evaluation. Both joint-level and sequential retrieval are single-level: neither scores queries or documents against the task objective.
blocks.zh: 程序生成期间联合级别检索运行:LLM在程序编辑的同时写查询,每个迭代必须至少调用Tavily一次,最多有3个工具回合. 序列检索,如DeepEvolve中,在每个迭代前运行一个深层研究代理. 鉴于目前被选为灵感的程序和计划,代理者计划研究问题,搜索网络,并撰写提案. 反思可以在判断报告不完整时重新进行规划或搜索;然后由编码代理人执行建议,然后调试和评价。 联合级和相继检索都是单级的:无论是查询还是文档,都没有比对任务目标.

blocks.en: EvoDuet couples query and solution evolution through a knowledge-gap gate ( § 3 ). The gate reads the current knowledge state and selects retrieve ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{retrieve}}} , look-up ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{look-up}}} , or no-op ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{no-op}}} . Under retrieve ¯ ¯ \overline{\underline{\textsc{retrieve}}} , the inner loop refines queries over R R rounds and selects documents using predicted program scores. The outer loop generates and evaluates programs, then stores the documents and measured outcomes in the search database to guide later gate decisions and queries.
blocks.zh: EvoDuet夫妇通过知识-gap门(§ 3)查询和解决进化. 闸门读取当前知识状态,并选择取回\ overline\ underline\ textsc{retrieve}, 抬头\ overline\ textsc{ look-up}}}} 或 no-op \ overline\ textsc{ NO-op}}}} 。 在 Release ` overline\ underline\ textsc{retrieve} 下, 内环通过 R R 回合改进查询, 并使用预测的程序分数选择文档 。 外环生成并评价程序,然后存储文档并在搜索数据库中测量结果,以指导后来的闸门决定和查询.

blocks.en: In the GPT-5.6-Luna trajectory analyzed in Section 2.3 , joint-level retrieval returns 85 distinct URLs versus 248 for EvoDuet ; 88.1% of its returned URLs are repeats. Across eligible four runs, mean NDG at iteration 100 is 43.2% on Denoising and 42.9% on Sums/Diffs, compared with 84.5% and 76.0% for EvoDuet (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: On Molecule and Burgers, DeepEvolve’s released scores are 0.8149 and 0.6666, respectively, below our OpenEvolve baseline (0.8496 and 0.6937); EvoDuet reaches 0.8524 and 0.7846 (Table 1(c) ). SINDy Cubic 2D ( Brunton et al., 2016 ) ( ↓ \downarrow NRMSE) The input consists of 2,500 samples from a two-dimensional trajectory.
The program returns the coefficients of a polynomial vector field 𝐱 ˙ = f ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \dot{\mathbf{x}}=f(\mathbf{x}) of degree at most three. The evaluator

accurately its integrated trajectory reproduces the reference trajectory.
The objective is to minimize the mean of the vector-field and trajectory
normalized root mean squared errors (NRMSEs). The initial program’s field and trajectory NRMSEs are 0.670 and 1.197,
respectively. The cubic-oscillator equation in the PySINDy oracle document
gives corresponding errors of approximately zero and 1.7 × 10 − 8 1.7\times 10^{-8} .

reactions A → B → C A\to B\to C . It returns a schedule of 501 temperature values

Database oracle has energy − 44.327 -44.327 .

OLYMPUS Perovskites ( Häse et al., 2021a ; Häse et al., 2021b ) ( ↓ \downarrow bandgap) The search space contains 192 compositions, each specified by an organic
component, a cation, and a halide. The program selects one composition, and

objective is to minimize this bandgap. The initial composition has a bandgap

tutorial oracle has a bandgap of 1.5249 eV.

GuacaMol C 11 H 24 ( Brown et al., 2019 ) ( ↑ \uparrow score) The program proposes molecular structures as SMILES strings, with
C 11 H 24 as the target molecular formula. The evaluator canonicalizes
and deduplicates the proposals, then averages their formula-agreement scores
over the top 159 structures. Missing structures contribute zero, so the
objective rewards a collection of distinct matching structures.
The initial program supplies 5 of the 159 structures and scores 0.0315.
The PubChem isomer list supplied by the oracle gives a score of 1.0.

Summit Baumgartner ( Felton et al., 2021 ; Baumgartner et al., 2019 ) ( ↑ \uparrow yield) The program specifies reaction conditions for an aniline C–N coupling:
catalyst, base, base loading, temperature, and residence time. Five released
emulators predict the yield under these conditions. Each prediction is
clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and the objective is to maximize their mean.
The initial conditions score 0.655. The conditions in a row of the released
dataset, identified by the oracle, score 1.0.

blocks.en: We use 21 tasks from SimpleTES ( WILL Team, 2026 ) , together with their released initial programs and evaluators. For each task, the released best program or construction is re-evaluated with the same evaluator and serves as the SOTA anchor for NDG. The tasks cover the six domains below.
blocks.zh: 我们使用来自SimleTES(Will Team,2026)的21项任务,以及他们发布的初始程序和评价人员. 对于每一项任务,发布的最佳程序或构建都由同一评价人员重新评价,并担任NDG的SOTA主播. 任务涵盖以下六个领域.

blocks.en: Swap Reduction searches over initial qubit mappings and routing decisions.
blocks.zh: 交换减少搜索在初始的qubit映射和路由决定上.

blocks.en:
Swap Reduction ( ↓ \downarrow SWAPs) Given a logical circuit and a device connectivity graph, a Rust routing
policy chooses the initial assignment of logical qubits to physical qubits
and inserts SWAP operations as the circuit is processed. The resulting
mapping must allow each two-qubit gate to execute on a hardware edge.
The optimization target is to reduce the number of inserted SWAPs. The evaluation scaffold contains 72 circuit–device cases across three
topologies. Its native score measures the CNOT overhead saved relative to
reference routings. In the paper, we report the number of added SWAPs on
the 24 circuits assigned to the 20-qubit device.
blocks.zh:
交换减少 (\\ 下行的全部门办法)
策略选择逻辑方位对物理方位的初始指派
并在处理线路时插入全部门办法。 结果
映射必须允许每个2qubit门在硬件边缘执行.
优化目标是减少插入的全部门办法的数目。 评估脚手架包含72个3个线路-设备案例
地形学. 其原生分数衡量所节省的 CNOT 间接费用相对于
参考路由. 在文件中,我们报告增加的全部门办法的数目。
分配给20qubit设备的24个电路。

blocks.en:
Each program returns a spacecraft trajectory as a sequence of launch,
flyby, deep-space maneuver, and arrival events, with an epoch and a state
for each event. The evaluator checks the trajectory using DE430 ephemerides
and two-body propagation, enforces the task’s time windows and minimum
flyby altitudes, and charges any speed mismatch at a flyby. The common
objective is to minimize the total velocity-change budget, in km/s, Δ ​ v total = Δ ​ v launch + Δ ​ v flybys + Δ ​ v maneuvers + Δ ​ v arrival . \Delta v_{\mathrm{total}}=\Delta v_{\mathrm{launch}}+\Delta v_{\mathrm{flybys}}+\Delta v_{\mathrm{maneuvers}}+\Delta v_{\mathrm{arrival}}. The five tasks differ in their destinations, permitted flyby bodies,
and arrival conditions.
blocks.zh:
每个程序返回一个航天器轨迹作为发射顺序,
飞行、深空机动和抵达事件,以及划时代和状态
每次活动。 评价员使用DE430麻黄素检查轨迹
和两体传播,执行任务的时间窗口和最小值
飞过高度, 并充电任何速度不匹配的飞行。 常见
目标是将总速度变化预算最小化,单位为km/s,  v 总计=Δ v 发射+Δ v 飞行+Δ v 操纵+Δ v 到达. \ Delta v_{\mathrm{ 总计 } 三角洲 v_{\mathrm{ 发射 }}+\ 德尔塔 v_{\mathrm{ flybys} 德尔塔 (原始内容存档于2019-09-31). v_{\mathrm{maneuvers}. Delta v_{\mathrm{到达}}。 这5项任务在目的地不同,允许飞行,
和到达条件。

blocks.en:
Cassini ( ↓ \downarrow Δ ​ v \Delta v ) The trajectory begins at Earth and ends with capture into a 115-day orbit
around Saturn. Flybys may use Venus, Earth, Mars, or Jupiter. A feasible
trajectory may contain at most six flybys and six deep-space maneuvers.

卡西尼(\\ downarrow \\\ v\德尔塔 v ) 轨迹从地球开始,最后进入115天的轨道
环绕着土星 飞行者可能使用金星,地球,火星或木星. 一个可行的
轨道最多可能包含6次飞行和6次深空飞行。

blocks.en: These tasks evaluate algorithms for statistical estimation. Single-Cell RNA-seq Denoising maximizes reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 这些任务评价统计估计的算法. 单Cell RNA-seq Denoising使重建质量最大化.

blocks.en:
Single-Cell RNA-seq Denoising ( ↑ \uparrow score) The input is a matrix of noisy unique molecular identifier (UMI) counts.
The program returns a denoised matrix of the same shape. For each dataset,
the evaluator averages a normalized mean-squared-error score and a
normalized Poisson score, with the additional requirement that the Poisson
score be at least 0.97. The objective is to maximize this combined score.
Program search uses the Pancreas dataset, while the reported result is the
mean score on the held-out PBMC and Tabula datasets.

程序返回相同形状的去诺化矩阵. 对于每个数据集,
平均平均平均平均平方分和
普瓦森分数正常 附加要求是普瓦森
得分至少为0.97分. 目标是使这一综合得分最大化。

PBMC和Tabula数据集的平均得分

blocks.en:
Each task asks the program to define a parametric predictive law and a
routine for fitting it. The law is fitted separately for each evaluation
group, subject to a task-specific parameter budget. Search is guided by
training R 2 R^{2} , whereas the paper reports held-out R 2 R^{2} , clipped to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . The tasks differ in their input variables, prediction targets,
and held-out regimes.
blocks.zh:
每项任务要求程序定义一个参数预测定律和一个
例行的装配 法律对每项评价分别适用
组,以特定任务参数预算为准. 搜索指南为
培训R 2 R^{2},而论文报告R 2 R^{2},剪辑为[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 。 任务在输入变量,预测目标,
和被扣留的政权。

blocks.en:
Domain Mixture ( ↑ \uparrow R 2 R^{2} ) The law predicts losses on five domains from the proportions of those
domains in a training mixture. Evaluation covers four model sizes, with
at most 35 fitted parameters per size. The test set contains 24 unseen
mixtures, measuring how well the fitted law predicts losses for mixtures
absent from training.
blocks.zh:
域间混合 (\\ oparrow R 2 R\ \ \ 2}) 法律预测五个领域的损失比例是:
在培训混合物中的域。 评价范围包括四个模式规模:
每个尺寸最多35个装配参数。 测试集包含24个隐形
混合物,衡量适用法对混合物损失的预测程度
未参加培训。

blocks.en:
U Shape ( ↑ \uparrow R 2 R^{2} ) The law predicts Brier score as a function of log compute on nine
benchmarks. Each benchmark permits at most six fitted parameters.
The held-out set contains 127 observations at higher compute, so the
reported score measures extrapolation beyond the training regime.

U 形状 (\\ oparrow R 2 R\\ 2}) 法律预测Brier分数是9分的算法
基准。 每个基准最多允许6个适当的参数。
被搁置的一组在较高的计算中包含127个观测数据,所以
报告衡量分数的措施超出培训制度。

blocks.en:
LR & BSZ ( ↑ \uparrow R 2 R^{2} ) The law predicts language-model loss from learning rate, batch size, data
size, and model parameter count, using at most 26 fitted parameters.
The test set contains 117 runs at a model size and data budget absent
from training, assessing transfer of the fitted relationship to that
held-out setting.

大小和模型参数计数,最多使用26个适配参数。
测试集包含117个运行的模型大小和数据预算缺失
从培训开始,评估适当关系向培训的转移
暂停设置。

blocks.en:
Parallel ( ↑ \uparrow R 2 R^{2} ) The law predicts loss from model parameter count and the number P P of
parallel streams. It is fitted on two datasets, with at most four
parameters per dataset. Training uses observations with P ≤ 4 P\leq 4 , and
evaluation uses P = 8 P=8 , testing extrapolation to a larger number of streams.

每个数据集的参数。 培训使用与P 4 P\leq 4的观测结果,以及

blocks.en:
We use two AtCoder Heuristic Contest problems from
ALE-Bench ( Imajuku et al., 2025 ) . For each task, a C++ solver is evaluated
on 150 public inputs with a 2 s limit per case. A run receives the sum of
the official case scores, or zero if any case fails. The reported task
score is the average over four runs.

我们使用两个AtCoder Heuristic Contest问题 从
ALE-Bench(Imajuku等人,2025年). 对每项任务评估一个 C++ 解析器
150个公共投入,每个案例2个限制。 运行得到的总和
官方案例的得分,或者任何案例失败时为零。 报告的任务

blocks.zh: C.2 甲骨文文档建设

blocks.en: For each task, we give Claude Code (Claude Opus 5 with maximum reasoning effort, restricted to its WebSearch and WebFetch tools) the task instructions, the initial program, the evaluator, and the best program released by SimpleTES. It identifies the functional differences that let the best program score higher, writes a web-search query for each, and returns the documents it fetched, each with a summary limited to what the document states. The resulting oracle documents are semantic rather than verbatim. Although the prompt asks for each document’s text as fetched, Claude Code’s WebFetch returns the output of a smaller model that reads the page rather than the page itself, so a document carries what its source says about an improvement, such as a method, a formula, or a parameter setting, but not necessarily its wording or its full content.
blocks.zh: 对于每一项任务,我们给克劳德代码(Claude Opus 5,以最大的推理努力,仅限于其WebSearch和WebFatch工具)任务指令,初始程序,评价者,以及SimpleTES发布的最佳程序. 它识别了让最佳程序得分更高的功能差异,为每个程序写一个网络搜索查询,并返回它获取的文档,每个文件有一个摘要,仅限于文档的内容. 由此产生的神谕文件是语义性的,而不是逐字记录。 虽然提示请求获取每个文档的文本, Claude Code 的 WebFetch 返回了一个读取页面而不是页面本身的较小模型的输出,所以一个文档带有其来源对改进的描述,例如方法,公式,或者参数设置,但不一定是其措辞或全部内容.

blocks.en: The oracle documents of these ten tasks were collected with Claude Code when the tasks were created. Each states the task’s solution directly, for example NIST’s certified parameters for Chwirut2 or the Cambridge Cluster Database coordinates for Lennard–Jones-13, and we validate the stated solution with the task’s evaluator; the boxes in Appendix C.1 give its score.

blocks.en: E.1 Behavior Flags and Additional Examples

blocks.en: We define the six behavior flags in Figure 8 , report additional retrieval patterns, and examine what the flags capture in individual runs. Appendix I provides the corresponding queries, sources, code edits, and evaluation results for seven worked cases.
blocks.zh: 我们在图8中定义了六个行为旗,报告额外的检索模式,并检查单个运行中捕获的旗帜是什么. 附 录 我提供相应的询问,来源,代码编辑,以及7个工作案例的评价结果.

blocks.en: E.1.1 Audit Setup and Counting Rules
blocks.zh: E.1.1 审计设置和计算规则

blocks.en: The GPT-5.6-Luna audit covers 8,200 iterations from 82 runs on the 21 tasks in the main results. The Gemini-3.8-Flash audit covers 14 runs on seven tasks and uses iterations with recorded gate decisions. For each iteration, we inspect the gate decision, queries, retained documents, predicted child scores, and the selected child’s changes relative to its parent. A document is promising when its predicted child score exceeds the parent’s score. We call a retrieval predicted to help if it retains at least one such document.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.6-Luna审计涵盖82项重复的8 200项主要结果中的21项任务。 双子座-3.8-Flash审计涵盖14项7项任务,并使用带有记录的大门决定的迭代. 对于每个周期,我们都会检查门的决定,询问,保留文件,预测孩子的分数,以及所选孩子相对于父母的变化。 当孩子的预期分数超过父母的分数时,文件是很有希望的。 我们要求检索,如果至少保留一个此类文件,预计会有帮助。

blocks.en: Each run is counted once per behavior, regardless of how often it occurs; categories can overlap. Regular expressions classify the final query as a known-result lookup, a method or implementation search, a problem-statement lookup, or other. The following rules identify candidate instances of each behavior. The case reviews below distinguish these flags from evidence that a retrieved idea was implemented and retained.
blocks.zh: 每次运行每行为一次计算,无论发生频率如何;类别可以重叠. 正则表达式将最终查询归类为已知结果查询,方法或执行查询,问题陈述查询或其他查询. 以下规则确定了每种行为的候选实例。 下面的案件审查将这些旗帜与证据区分开来,表明已执行并保留了检索到的想法。

blocks.en: • Method transfer: A retrieved method or implementation detail becomes a program component. We flag a run when a method or implementation query retrieves a promising document and the child sets a new run best. • Cross-domain transfer: The model adapts a method or artifact from another scientific field. The flag requires a new run best with a retained document from another field, identified by its title and host. General-purpose numerical tools, such as L-BFGS, trust-region methods, and SciPy, are excluded. • Live documentation lookup: Retrieving documentation to check an interface. The flag requires an API, signature, version, release-note, or documentation query; a retained documentation page; and a child that beats its parent. It does not require a verified API correction. • Target-informed reconstruction: A published value or construction guides development of a solver. We flag a run when a known-result query retrieves a promising document and the child sets a new run best, with no runtime download, copied code line, or pasted numerical solution. • Public artifact reuse: A selected child downloads a published witness or solution at run time, or embeds numerical values from a published solution. Both forms are manually checked. • Evidence-inspired over-reach: A retrieval predicted to help produces a child whose score falls below its parent’s by more than 10% of the run’s total gain. Runs with no positive total gain do not receive this flag.
blocks.zh: • 支助 方法传输 : 检索的方法或执行细节成为程序组成部分。 当一个方法或执行查询检索到一个很有希望的文件时,我们标出运行的标记,而孩子设置新的运行最好。 • 跨界转让: 该模型从另一个科学领域改造一种方法或文物. 旗帜需要用另一个字段保存的文档进行最优的新运行,该文档由其标题和主机识别. 通用数字工具,如L-BFGS、信任区域方法和SciPy,不包括在内。 • 支助 实时文档搜索 : 获取文档以检查接口 。 旗帜需要一个API,签名,版本,发布符,或文档查询;一个保留文档页;以及一个击败其父母的孩子. 它不需要经过核实的API更正. • 目标明确的重建: 已公布的数值或构建指导解决器的开发. 我们标记一个运行, 当已知结果查询检索到一个有希望的文档, 而孩子设置一个新的运行最好, 没有运行时间下载, 复制代码行, 或粘贴的数字解决方案。 • 公共文物再利用: 被选中的儿童在运行时下载已公布的目击证人或解决方案,或者从已公布的解决方案嵌入数值. 手动检查两种表格 。 • 证据激发的过度接触: 预想会帮助一个孩子的分数低于父母的10%以上。 没有正总收益的运行不会收到此旗帜.

blocks.en: Target-informed reconstruction: A published value or construction guides development of a solver. We flag a run when a known-result query retrieves a promising document and the child sets a new run best, with no runtime download, copied code line, or pasted numerical solution.
blocks.zh: 目标知情重建: 已公布的数值或构建指导解决器的开发. 我们标记一个运行, 当已知结果查询检索到一个有希望的文档, 而孩子设置一个新的运行最好, 没有运行时间下载, 复制代码行, 或粘贴的数字解决方案。

blocks.en: Public artifact reuse: A selected child downloads a published witness or solution at run time, or embeds numerical values from a published solution. Both forms are manually checked.
blocks.zh: 公共文物再利用: 被选中的儿童在运行时下载已公布的目击证人或解决方案,或者从已公布的解决方案嵌入数值. 手动检查两种表格 。

blocks.en: Evidence-inspired over-reach: A retrieval predicted to help produces a child whose score falls below its parent’s by more than 10% of the run’s total gain. Runs with no positive total gain do not receive this flag.
blocks.zh: 证据启发的过度普及:一个预言会帮助生产出一个其分数低于其父母总收益的10%以上的孩子的检索。 没有正总收益的运行不会收到此旗帜.

blocks.en: Direct code copying occurs in 19 GPT-5.6-Luna iterations (0.2%): 16 copy a single line containing an import, path, or function signature, and three copy part of a Sums/Diffs integer set. The numeric-copy check flags added code containing at least three numbers with five or more significant digits that appear together, exactly or after rounding, on a page retrieved by that iteration. Manual review identifies 59 GPT-5.6-Luna iterations (0.7%) in four runs: three reuse published Rosetta trajectories or flyby dates, and one reuses an AC2 step-function construction. Only one of these four runs retains a copied solution in its final best program. One Gemini-3.8-Flash iteration reuses an AC1 construction. We also inspect runtime network calls; an AHC039 identifier that matches the download detector is excluded as a false positive.
blocks.zh: 直接代码复制发生在19个GPT-5.6-Luna迭代(0.2%):16个复制包含导入,路径,或函数签名的单行,以及3个复制部分的Sums/diffs整数集. 数字复制检查旗上添加了至少包含3个数字的代码,其中5个或5个以上重要数字在复数检索的页面上准确或四舍五入后一起出现。 人工审查确定59 GPT-5.6-Luna迭代(0.7%)共4次:3次再利用,公布Rosetta轨迹或飞日期,1次再利用AC2步函数构造. 这4个运行中只有1个在其最终的最佳程序中保留了复制的解决方案. 一个双子座-3.8-闪电迭代重用一个AC1构造. 我们还检查运行时的网络呼叫;一个匹配下载检测器的AHC039标识符不作为假阳性.

blocks.en: Search miss with own progress denotes a new run best after a retrieval with no promising document (57 of 82 GPT-5.6-Luna runs). Identifier fixation denotes a PR or issue number, or an arXiv identifier, appearing in at least 30% of a run’s retrieval queries; this is assessed only for runs with at least ten retrievals (6 of 75). Figure 8 (b) separately measures whether the selected child beats its parent or the previous run best, including at iterations without search. Appendix E.3 compares program revision outcomes with and without documents across all three models.
blocks.zh: 自行进度的搜索失败表示在检索后最好进行新的运行,没有前景的文件(82 GPT-5.6-Luna运行中的57次)。 标识符固定表示一个PR或问题号,或arXiv标识符,至少出现在运行中30%的检索查询中;这只被评估为至少有10次检索的运行(75次中有6次)。 图8 (b) 单独衡量被选中的儿童是比其父母好还是比前一次跑得最好,包括在重复时不进行搜索。 附录E.3将方案修订结果与所有三种模式的文件进行比较。

blocks.en: E.1.2 What the Worked Cases Establish
blocks.zh: 经济及社会理事会 已开展工作的案例

blocks.en: At iteration 5, the gate describes the stored documents as “largely conceptual”. The retrieved dSABRE paper supplies exponential depth weighting, which becomes a term in the SWAP scorer and remains in every later best program. The final router adds 14,835 14{,}835 SWAPs on Q20, compared with 15,186 15{,}186 for the released SimpleTES program under the same evaluator. This case verifies implementation and persistence of a retrieved mechanism, beyond the method-transfer flag assigned to 55 of 82 runs.
blocks.zh: 在第五版中,大门将所储存的文件描述为“主要是概念性的”。 收回的dSABRE纸提供指数深度权重,成为全部门办法计分器中的一个术语,并留在以后的每一个最佳方案中。 最终路由器在Q20上增加了14,835 14{,}835 SWAP,而在同一评价器下发布的SimleTES方案则增加了15,186 15{,}186. 这一案例核查了回收机制的执行情况和持久性,超出了82次运行中分配给55次的方法转让旗帜。

blocks.en: The model retrieves a low-sidelobe radar codeword, 04CF5A2471657C6F , and uses it to seed an optimizer for an additive number-theory problem. All four subsequent improvements to the run best retain the codeword, reducing C 5 C_{5} from 0.381374 to 0.380915. The first improvement follows a look-up two iterations after retrieval. Inspection of the 13 flagged runs also finds weaker cases: the Anscombe transform is retrieved in three Denoising runs but appears in no candidate, while a quadratic-residue initialization appears in ten selected Erdős children but is absent from that run’s best program. By comparison, a variable-projection formulation introduced on Parallel Scaling at iteration 30, which accounts for 56% of that run’s gain, remains in its best program at iteration 84. A cross-domain source alone therefore does not establish lasting transfer.
blocks.zh: 该型号回收了一个低侧面雷达密码词,即04CF5A2471657C6F,并用它来播种一个用于添加剂数理论问题的优化器. 随后对最佳运行的四处改进都保留了代码词,将C 5 C_{5}从0.381374减少到0.380915. 第一个改进是在检索后进行两次检索。 检查这13条标注的跑线也发现一些较弱的案例:Anscombe变速器在3条德诺瓦兴变速器中被收回,但没有出现在任何候选机上,而在10个选定的埃尔达斯儿童中则出现了四重应变,但没有出现在该跑线的最佳方案中。 相比之下,在30号频率上引入的关于平行增强的可变预测方案占该运行收益的56%,在84号频率上仍处于最佳方案之中。 因此,单靠一个跨域源并不能确立持久的转移。

blocks.en: The rule flags 72 retrievals in 27 runs; 13 of these iterations set a new best. Of the 72, 21 ask for an astrodynamics wrapper already documented in the task prompt, and 18 target a pull-request diff. In Voyager 2, 28 of 46 retrievals name the wrapper, but the retained pages describe public Lambert solvers. At iteration 41, a new tour reduces Δ ​ v \Delta v from 3.457 to 3.447 km/s and explicitly passes lowpath=True, M=0 . These are the existing defaults, so they do not change the solver branch; the final best program does not descend from this child. Across 300 wrapper-targeting retrievals, only two retain a page from the benchmark’s source, and neither improves on its parent. The flag thus captures documentation-seeking behavior more broadly than verified API corrections.
blocks.zh: 规则旗 72 检索在 27 运行; 其中 13 个这些迭代设置了新的最佳. 在72架中,21架要求安装在任务提示中已经记录到的天体动力学包装机,18架瞄准了牵引请求diff. 在Voyager 2中,46个检索器中有28个将包装器命名,但保留页描述了公共的Lambert解析器. 在41号列车中,新巡演将QQ v\Delta v从3.457km/s减少到3.447km/s,并明确通过低路=. 没错 M=0 这些是现有的默认,所以它们不会改变解析器分支;最终的最佳程序不会从这个孩子降下来. 在300个包装目标检索中,只有两页保留了基准来源的页面,其母部分也没有改进。 因此,该旗帜比经核实的API更正更宽泛地捕捉到文件搜索行为.

blocks.en: The first query names a best-known sum of radii, 2.635977. The returned pages supply no coordinates, and the model writes an LP-plus-SLSQP solver that raises the objective from 1.390 to 2.628 in one iteration. At iteration 7, it reaches 2.635983, exceeding the queried target and matching the SimpleTES reference to six decimals. Later queries seek the record holder’s source file, but the best program contains a generated solver with no retrieved coordinates or runtime download. Target-informed reconstruction is flagged in 40 of 82 GPT-5.6-Luna runs and 12 of 14 Gemini-3.8-Flash runs.
blocks.zh: 最早的查询名称是最著名的radi总称,2.635977. 返回的页面提供无坐标,模型写一个LP-plus-SLSQP解析器,将一个迭代中的目标从1.390提高到2.628. 在7号迭代时,它达到了2.635983,超过了被询问的目标,并将SimpleTES的参考值比作小数点后的6个。 后来的查询寻求记录持有人的源文件,但最好的程序包含一个生成的解析器,没有检索坐标或运行时间下载. 82个GPT-5.6-Luna运行中的40个和14个双子座-3.8-Flash运行中的12个都标注了目标知情重建。

blocks.en: At iteration 17, the child downloads a published witness and retains its optimizer as a fallback, reducing the run’s best C 5 C_{5} from 0.381017 to 0.380859. The best program without a runtime download reaches 0.381004. The program reported in the Erdős row of Table 1(a) retains this download, so its result depends on access to the published artifact (Appendix K ). Two of 82 GPT-5.6-Luna runs download artifacts at run time; four others embed published numerical solutions, including three Rosetta trajectories or sets of flyby dates.
blocks.zh: 在第17集,孩子下载了一位已公布的证人,并保留了作为倒计时的优化器,使得该集最佳C 5 C_{5}从0.381017降至0.380859. 没有运行时间下载的最好程序达到0.381004. 表1(a)的Erdás行中所报告的程序保留了这一下载,因此其结果取决于能否访问已出版的文物(Appendix K ). 82GPT-5.6-Luna运行运行时下载文物的2个;另外4个嵌入了已公布的数字解决方案,包括3个罗塞塔轨迹或飞日期套.

blocks.en: At iteration 33, a document’s predicted child score is 0.63701 (parent: 0.63692), but the rewrite scores 0.37713, raising Δ ​ v \Delta v from 1.926 to 3.873 km/s. The run best remains 0.63692; iteration 34 recovers this score from a different parent without retrieval. Across GPT-5.6-Luna runs, 20% of retrievals predicted to help produce a worse child, and 29 of 82 runs contain a drop exceeding 10% of their total gain. Predicted gains therefore require validation by the evaluator.
blocks.zh: 在迭代33,一个文档的预测儿童分数为0.63701(家长:0.63692),但重写得分为0.37713,将QQ v\Delta v从1.926升至3.873 km/s. 运行最优仍为0.63692;迭代34从不同的家长那里收回这个分数而无需检索. 通过GPT-5.6-Luna运行,预计20%的检索有助于生产更差的孩子,82次运行中有29次的下降超过其总收益的10%。 因此,预期的收益需要评价人员加以验证。

blocks.en: E.3 Failure Analysis of Retrieved Evidence Use

blocks.en: We analyze 33,784 iterations from 362 EvoDuet runs across the 21 tasks with Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-5.6-Luna, and Gemini-3.8-Flash at N ∈ { 1 , 8 } N\in\{1,8\} . We consider each run’s first 100 iterations and exclude iterations with recorded external service errors. Document exposure is verified from the generation prompt. Outcomes compare the selected child’s recorded search score with its parent’s.

blocks.en: Qwen’s failures with documents extend beyond evaluation errors. At N = 1 N=1 , Qwen fails evaluation in 12.4% of document iterations versus 9.2% without documents (Figure 16 (a)). Only 27.7% improve on the parent, versus 41.1% for Luna and 31.8% for Gemini; 33.2% produce a lower score and 12.9% retain no child. Evaluation errors alone therefore miss revisions that execute but fail to improve.
blocks.zh: Quen在文件上的失败超出了评价错误。 在N=1 N=1时,Quen在12.4%的重复文件中未进行评价,而在9.2%的重复文件中未进行评价(图16(a))。 父母中只有27.7%的情况有所改善,而月球为41.1%,双子座为31.8%;33.2%的得分较低,12.9%没有子女。 因此,仅评价错误就错过了执行但未能改进的修订。

blocks.en: Qwen improves more often when selecting from parallel candidates. At N = 8 N=8 , Qwen’s document iterations improve on the parent in 49.3% of cases and fail evaluation in 1.1%. blocks.en: Retrieved methods are unused or incorrectly implemented in 26% of sampled Qwen revisions. Codex inspected 50 revisions sampled uniformly from 2,980 eligible Qwen revisions with documents and retained code at N = 1 N=1 . Methods were unused in 3 (6%) and incorrectly implemented in 10 (20%); 22 incorporated or retained a method, 7 lacked actionable evidence, and 8 were uncertain. These model-assessed sample proportions exclude external errors and count only specific new discrepancies with supplied methods. Table 11 provides separate examples; Denoising’s score decrease cannot be attributed to its transform error alone.

blocks.en: Our experiments cover GPT-5.6-Luna, Gemini-3.8-Flash, and Qwen3.5-9B. The benefits of EvoDuet vary across these models: Qwen3.5-9B has lower overall NDG with EvoDuet than with OpenEvolve alone at both N = 1 N=1 and N = 8 N=8 . Our analysis also identifies cases in which this model ignores retrieved methods or implements them incorrectly. Evaluating more model families and sizes, and examining whether training for evidence selection and implementation reduces these failures, would help establish when a backbone can benefit from bi-level co-evolution.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验包括GPT-5.6-Luna,双子座-3.8-Flash,以及Quen3.5-9B. EvoDuet的好处因这些模式而异: Quen3.5-9B与EvoDuet的总NDG比OpenEvolve单独在N=1N=1和N=8N=8时更低. 我们的分析还查明了这种模型忽视检索方法或错误地执行方法的情况。 评估更多的模范家庭和规模,审查证据选择和执行培训是否减少这些失败,将有助于确定一个骨干何时能够从双层共同演变中受益。

blocks.en: EvoDuet does not consistently improve performance on algorithm engineering tasks such as AHC039 and AHC058. Figure 6(b) shows lower group-average NDG than OpenEvolve in four of the six model/budget settings, with an average decline of 1.6% across all six. These losses occur with both GPT-5.6-Luna and Qwen3.5-9B at N = 1 N=1 and N = 8 N=8 . Further work is needed to determine how evidence selection, adaptation to task-specific heuristics, and the allocation of search effort contribute to these failures, and to improve the framework on these tasks.
blocks.zh: EvoDuet在AHC039和AHC058等算法工程任务上的性能并没有一致改进. 图6(b)显示,在六个模式/预算设置中,四个模式/预算设置的组别平均NDG低于OpenEvolve,所有六个模式/预算都平均下降1.6%。 这些损失发生在GPT-5.6-Luna和Quen3.5-9B的N=1N=1和N=8N=8。 需要开展进一步的工作,以确定证据选择、适应具体任务的弹性以及搜索努力的分配如何促成这些失败,并改进这些任务的框架。

blocks.en: Scientific discovery often requires interpreting visual observations from experiments ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) , motivating the use of vision-language models ( Lee et al., 2024d ; Lee et al., 2024e ; Lee et al., 2024c ; Lee et al., 2024a ; Lee et al., 2024b ; Lee et al., 2025a ; Lee et al., 2025b ; Lee et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026d ; Lee et al., 2026a ; Cho et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026c ) as mutation operators in our solution optimization loop. In our current framework, the inner loop evolves search queries, while the outer loop generates each candidate solution in a single turn, conditioned on the parent program, evolutionary history, and any retrieved evidence. Extending this bi-level co-evolution paradigm to multi-turn interactions ( Lee et al., 2024f ; Lee et al., 2024h ; Lee et al., 2024i ; Lee et al., 2024g ; Lee et al., 2025d ; Lee et al., 2025c ) could enable the model to revisit explored lineages and iteratively refine both queries and solutions within a shared conversational context.
blocks.zh: 科学发现往往需要从实验中解释视觉观测(Sun等人,2025年;Ma等人,2026年),激励使用视觉语言模型(Lee等人,2024年d;Lee等人,2024年e; Lee等人,2024c;Lee等人,2024a; Lee等人,2024b;Lee等人,2025a; Lee et al., 2025b; Lee et al., 2026b; Kang et al., 2026; Lee et al., 2026d; Lee et al., 2026a; Cho et al., 2026; Yu et al., 2026; Kim et al., 2026b; Kang et al., 2026c) 是我们溶液优化循环中的变异操作器. 在我们目前的框架中,内环会演化搜索查询,而外环则以母程序,进化历史,以及任何检索到的证据为条件,以单转生成每个候选解决方案. 将这一双层共同演变模式扩大到多回合互动(Lee等人,2024f;Lee等人,2024h;Lee等人,2024i); Lee et al., 2024g ; Lee et al., 2025d ; Lee et al., 2025c)可以使模型在共同对话的背景下重新审视探索的世系并反复完善询问和解决方案.

blocks.en: The benefits of oracle documents vary across models and tasks. On Swap Reduction, the same documents raise NDG by 6.1% for Qwen3.5-9B and 41.5 for GPT-5.6-Luna, while both models lose performance on Rosetta (Figure 3(c) ). Qwen’s positive average oracle gain also shows that its losses with EvoDuet do not imply a general inability to use documents. Those losses may reflect difficulties in identifying knowledge gaps, retrieving relevant evidence, or implementing it. The unused methods and incorrect implementations in Appendix E.3 provide examples of the last difficulty. These observations motivate training and evaluating evidence selection and implementation as separate skills, while accounting for baseline performance and search budget.
blocks.zh: 甲骨文文件的好处因模型和任务而异. 在互换还原上,同一文件将Quen3.5-9B的NDG提高了6.1%,GPT-5.6-Luna提高了41.5,而这两个型号在Rosetta上都失去了性能(图3(c)). EvoDuet的损失并不意味着一般无法使用文件。 这些损失可能反映了在查明知识差距、检索相关证据或加以实施方面的困难。 附录E.3中未使用的方法和不正确的执行提供了最后困难的例子。 这些意见激励培训和评价证据选择和执行,将其作为单独的技能,同时说明基线业绩和搜索预算。

blocks.en: EvoDuet may make computational scientific discovery more efficient by helping researchers find and apply relevant knowledge from the web. However, unreliable sources can lead to incorrect conclusions, while reusing published solutions can result in overstated claims of novelty. To support auditing, we record retrieval and optimization trajectories. We also recommend explicit source attribution, independent validation of generated programs, and human oversight of downstream applications.
blocks.zh: EvoDuet通过帮助研究人员从网上找到和应用相关知识,可以提高计算科学发现的效率. 然而,不可靠的来源可能导致错误的结论,而重新使用已公布的解决方案则可能导致对新事物的夸大其词. 为了支持审计,我们记录检索和优化轨迹. 我们还建议明确来源归属,独立验证生成的程序,以及人对下游应用的监督.

blocks.en: Exponential depth weighting from dSABRE remains in every later best program, providing evidence of method transfer . The final router adds 14,835 14{,}835 SWAPs on Q20, compared with SimpleTES’s 15,186 15{,}186 under the same evaluator. This advantage is specific to Q20 (Appendix K ). Iteration 5 introduces the weighting; later edits tune it. Increasingly specific queries show identifier fixation : 79 of 94 retrievals name Qiskit PR #14912 without obtaining its diff. Iteration 77 sets a new best after another retrieval with no promising document, an instance of search miss with own progress .

blocks.en: Iteration 33 illustrates evidence-inspired over-reach : a document with predicted child score 0.63701 is retained against a parent scoring 0.63692, but the child scores 0.37713 as Δ ​ v \Delta v rises from 1.926 to 3.873 km/s. It does not replace the run’s best. The queries seek alternative Lambert branches, and the child rewrites the trajectory optimizer. Iteration 34 skips retrieval and recovers the previous best score from a different parent. The measured best remains 0.63692 throughout.

blocks.en: The runs of EvoDuet use the prompts below; templates are reproduced with the em dash replaced by a semicolon, and braces mark fields filled at run time. The gate (Prompt ) runs at every iteration. On retrieve , the population analysis runs once, with Prompt as its system message, reused unchanged from EvoX ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , and the population statistics computed in code as its user message. The inner loop then writes its first query with Prompt and each later query with Prompt , and scores the new documents of every round with Prompt . These calls send the template as a user message with no system message. Prompts and are formats written in code: how a document appears in the {search_context} field, and how the retained documents enter the scaffold’s solution prompt, between the current program and the task instruction. The {search_database} field is the snapshot described in Appendix B.2 . Prompt is used only by the random and stagnation gates of Table 1(b) , which make no gate call and write the knowledge state after the population analysis instead.

blocks.en: K.2 Rosetta: refining a published tour lowers maneuver cost
blocks.zh: K.2 罗塞塔:完善已出版的巡回演出,降低操控成本

blocks.en: The program initializes the Earth–Earth–Mars–Earth–Earth–67P tour from published GTOPX trajectory values and refines its encounter times, flybys, and deep-space maneuvers with differential evolution and Powell optimization. It enforces unpowered flybys under the task’s 300 km altitude floor and fixed arrival date, reducing total Δ ​ v \Delta v from 1.552968 to 1.396424 km/s (10.1%). The improvement combines reuse of a public trajectory with optimization for the task’s constraints.
blocks.zh: 该方案从公布的GTOPX轨迹值中初始化了地球-地球-火星-地球-地球-67P巡演,并完善了它的遇机时间,飞行,以及具有不同进化和鲍威尔优化的深空动作. 它在任务300公里高地和固定到达日期下执行无动力飞行,将总计XQ v\Delta v从1.552968降至1.396424 km/s(10.1%). 这种改进将重新利用公共轨道与优化任务限制结合起来。

blocks.en: K.3 Voyager 2: constrained refinement improves the existing tour
blocks.zh: K.3级 Voyager 2: 有限的改进改进了现有的巡演

blocks.en: The program retains the Earth–Jupiter–Saturn–Uranus–Neptune tour without deep-space maneuvers, first fitting unpowered flybys by least squares and then minimizing boundary Δ ​ v \Delta v with SLSQP. The selected trajectory arrives at the upper bound of the allowed window and reduces total Δ ​ v \Delta v from 3.430214 to 3.430206 km/s. The small gain reflects tighter numerical refinement of the same tour.
blocks.zh: 这个程序保留了地球 – Jupiter – Saturn – Uranus – Neptune 巡演,不进行深空操作,首先通过最小的方块安装无动力飞行器,然后与 SLSQP 最小化边界 → v\Delta v 。 所选的轨迹到达允许窗口的上方界限,将总计QQ v\Delta v从3.430214降至3.430206 km/s. 这一小收益反映了对同一旅行进行更严格的数字改进。

blocks.en: K.4 Denoising: mixing diffusion operators improves average accuracy
blocks.zh: 第4条 Denoising:混合扩散操作员提高平均准确度

blocks.en: The program builds one MAGIC graph and mixes its ordinary diffusion output with a self-loop-free version using cell-specific weights, followed by shrinkage and gene calibration. Its held-out mean score increases from 0.722690 to 0.722906. The gain on PBMC (0.7116 vs. 0.7090) is partly offset by a loss on Tabula (0.7342 vs. 0.7364).
blocks.zh: 程序构建了一个MAGIC图,并将其普通的扩散输出与使用细胞特异性权重的无自落式版本混合,然后进行缩水和基因校准. 其被搁置的平均得分从0.722690增加到0.722906. PBMC的增益(0.7116 vs. 0.7090)被Tabula的损失(0.7342 vs. 0.7364)部分抵销.

blocks.en: K.5 Domain Mixture: separate domain fits improve held-out prediction
blocks.zh: K.5 域混合:单独的域适合改进预留

blocks.en: The program fits a separate seven-parameter law for each of five domains, combining an exponential function of mixture contrasts with a log-share correction for the domain’s own data fraction. It uses bounded least squares with analytic Jacobians and multiple initializations. The resulting held-out R 2 R^{2} is 0.997062, compared with 0.996922 for the reference.
blocks.zh: 这个程序为五个域中的每一个域分别配有7个参数定律,将混合物对比的指数函数与对域自身数据分数的对数修正相结合. 它使用边框最小的方块与分析雅各比亚人和多个初始化. 由此产生的R 2 R^{2}为0.997062,而参考文献为0.996922。

blocks.en: K.7 Erdős: public witnesses support a small numerical refinement
blocks.zh: K.7 Erdás:公众证人支持小幅数字改进

blocks.en: The program downloads public witness vectors, checks their feasibility, and refines the one with the smallest maximum overlap using SLSQP. Its recorded bound of 0.380859056341 improves the SimpleTES reference of 0.380867675827. Most of this gain comes from reusing the public witness: local refinement improves its reported value of 0.3808590566 by only about 2.6 × 10 − 10 2.6\times 10^{-10} .

blocks.en: The program builds order-28 Hadamard matrices from Goethals–Seidel, Paley, and Williamson constructions, borders them to order 29, and refines them by tabu search with rank-one determinant updates. The resulting matrix has | det | = 2 28 ⋅ 320 ⋅ 7 12 |\det|=2^{28}\cdot 320\cdot 7^{12} and a normalized score of 0.935673. This matches the reference determinant.

blocks.en: The program sweeps generalized Penman–Wells constructions across eleven moduli, ranks them by exact bitmask counts, and refines the best candidates through element additions, removals, swaps, and perturbations. The selected 509-element set has 3,575 distinct sums and 2,793 distinct differences, yielding c = 1.144999 c=1.144999 versus 1.144887 for the released post-training construction. An independent replay reproduces these counts and the score exactly.
blocks.zh: 这项计划将泛泛的Penman –  Wells 构造横跨11个moduli,按精确的位图计数排列,并通过元素添加、清除、互换和扰动来完善最佳候选人。 选用的509单元有3 575个不同数额和2 793个不同差额,其中C=1.14999 c=1.1449999,而放行的训练后建筑为1.14487。 独立重播会复制这些计数和准确的分数.

blocks.en: The program starts from varied six-row layouts, maximizes radii through linear programming, and jointly refines centers and radii with SLSQP. Collective deformations and local perturbations explore nearby packing configurations, yielding a sum of radii of 2.635983084918461. An independent replay passes the evaluator’s boundary and non-overlap checks; the score matches the reference within 10 − 9 10^{-9} .

blocks.en: The program explores five- and six-row layouts with SLSQP, then alternates linear optimization of radii at fixed centers with joint center–radius refinement. Small perturbations and restarts yield a sum of radii of 2.939572771209394. An independent replay passes the evaluator’s boundary and non-overlap checks; the score matches the reference within 10 − 9 10^{-9} .

blocks.en: Figures 17 – 21 visualize the routed quantum circuits, trajectories, denoised gene expression, scaling laws, and mathematical objects produced by the best programs, alongside those from the programs or constructions released by SimpleTES. They are redrawn from saved outputs; the mathematical objects come from re-running each best program, which reproduces its reported score exactly.
blocks.zh: 图17 — 21可视化最佳程序产生的路由量子电路、轨迹、去诺化基因表达、缩放定律和数学对象,以及SimpleTES发布的程序或构造。 它们是从保存的输出中重新绘制的;数学对象来自每个最佳程序的重运行,它完全复制了其报告的分数.

blocks.en: Figure 17: Routed quantum circuits on Q20. (a) The alu-v0_27 input circuit. (b, c) Outputs of the released SimpleTES program and EvoDuet ’s best program under matched replay settings. Colored bands highlight inserted SWAPs: two for SimpleTES and one for EvoDuet . All gates are shown; only idle wires are omitted. Labels q i q_{i} and p i p_{i} denote logical qubits and physical sites, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图17:Q20上的路由量子电路. (a) au-v0_27输入电路。 (b,c) 发布SimleTES程序和EvoDuet在匹配的重播设置下的最佳程序的产出。 彩色带突出插入的全部门办法:SimleTES有两个,EvoDuet有一个。 所有门都显示;只省略闲置的电线. Labels q i q i}和 p i p_{i}分别表示逻辑方位和物理站点.

blocks.en: Figure 18: Rosetta and Voyager 2. (a, b) Encounters and dates of the SimpleTES construction and of the best program of EvoDuet ; diamonds are deep-space maneuvers labelled with their Δ ​ v \Delta v in km/s. (c) Total Δ ​ v \Delta v split into maneuvers and launch or arrival. On Rosetta, EvoDuet adds the Mars flyby of the actual mission; on Voyager 2, both follow the same tour and EvoDuet moves the arrival onto the end of the window. Planet images: NASA (public domain).
blocks.zh: 图18:Rosetta和Voyager 2. (a,b) SimpleTES的构建和EvoDuet最佳方案的对峙和日期;钻石是深空操作,以公里/秒标注在它们 v\\Delta v 上。 (c) 总计______ v\Delta v 分为战术和发射或抵达。 在Rosetta上,EvoDuet增加了实际任务中的火星飞行器;在Voyager 2上,两者都遵循相同的巡演,EvoDuet将到达点移动到窗口的尽头. 行星影像: NASA (公有领域).

blocks.en: Figure 19: Denoised gene expression. (a) Noisy PBMC input, (b, c) outputs of the released SimpleTES program and EvoDuet ’s best program, and (d) held-out counts. Columns show all 1,087 cells; rows show 24 genes selected for their variability in the input. Gene selection and ordering use only the input, with the same order and color scale across panels. Values are log-normalized per cell. Held-out counts are independent observations and still contain noise.
blocks.zh: 图19:去诺化基因表达. (a) 无声PBMC输入,(b,c) 发布的SimleTES程序和EvoDuet最佳程序的产出,以及(d) 搁置计数。 列显示所有1,087个细胞;列显示24个基因在输入中因其可变性被选中. 基因选择和顺序只使用输入,不同面板的顺序和颜色尺度相同. 每个单元格的数值为对数正常。 搁置的计数是独立的观测结果,仍然含有噪音。

blocks.en: Figure 20: Parallel Scaling and Domain Mixture. (a) Observed loss on the grid of parameter count N N and parallel streams P P for the two Parallel datasets (darker cells indicate lower loss within each dataset); the dashed row ( P = 8 P=8 ) is held out, and a star marks the law that predicts that cell more closely ( EvoDuet in 7 of 12). (b) Predicted against actual held-out loss on Domain Mixture. (c) Held-out 1 − R 2 1-R^{2} on a log scale. Both margins are small.
